_comment: EXPERIMENT (2026-07-21): what if a very powerful model DESIGNS the class? Creative roles (brainstorm = cloud/cluster + relic-intent; structure = map/compose + blueprint, i.e. the actual class design) go to Kimi K3 (2.8T reasoning model) via OpenRouter — it is NOT on Ollama Cloud (catalog tops out at kimi-k2.7-code). Cards stay on glm-5.2 @ Ollama Cloud exactly as prod, so the only variable is the designer. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY + OLLAMA_API_KEY in generation/.env. Run via: uv run python tools/ab_compare.py --concept "..." --only ollama --ollama-config ollama_roles.kimi3.json --out scratch/ab_<slug>_kimi3.md  (and a second run with no --ollama-config as the cheap-designer baseline).

roles._kimi_comment: K3 is a reasoning model: reasoning streams in delta.reasoning (ignored by our parser, but it keeps the stream alive) and the answer lands in delta.content — smoke-verified 2026-07-21 through OpenAICompatGenerator, temperature accepted too (kept at parity with the baseline mix). max_tokens_floor raises tiny stage budgets (relic-intent asks 2000) because hidden reasoning bills against max_tokens BEFORE any content — the smoke test burned 2000 tokens of pure reasoning and truncated. Generous timeout: reasoning can run long between visible chunks. $3/M in, $15/M out — reasoning tokens bill as output.

_fallback_comment: Explicit so a mid-forge Ollama quota trip (from the cards role) does NOT silently swap the designer: kimi roles 'fail over' to the same kimi-k3 slug (their primary already IS OpenRouter), cards fail over to glm on OpenRouter as usual.
